name: Hurricane Ian

narrative.0: Impact: catastrophic surge on Fort Myers Beach. Hurricane-force winds inland.

narrative.48: Surge recedes. Barrier islands cut off.
narrative.168: Recovery: long rebuilds on the islands. Inland sites reopen.
